title: Finding Your Name, Constituency, Polling Station and BLO
summary: The official portal lets you search the electoral roll by EPIC number or by personal details, and separately locate your polling station and BLO contact details.
body:
If you don't know whether you're registered, don't know your constituency, or don't know your polling station or BLO:

- Use 'Search in Electoral Roll' on voters.eci.gov.in with your EPIC number, or with name/father's-or-mother's-name/age/address details if you don't have your EPIC number.
- Use the polling-station locator on the same portal or the Voter Helpline App to find your assigned polling station and directions.
- Use the BLO/officials lookup (or 'Book-a-Call with BLO' on ECINET) to find and contact your Booth Level Officer.

This is always the first step VoteAssist recommends before starting any application, since it avoids duplicate registrations.
caution: Confirm the current search fields/flow on voters.eci.gov.in, since portal forms are periodically redesigned.
